details:
A rich and intuitive set of strongly-typed assertions to use for unit testing (either with JUnit or TestNG).  

Security Fix(es):  

  * assertj: AssertJ: Information disclosure and denial of service via XML External Entity (XXE) (CVE-2026-24400)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
